title: Fourth moment bound for a centered linear square
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $a$ be a real coefficient vector indexed by $n$ coordinates, and let $X$ be uniformly distributed on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube. Define $Q(X)=(\sum_i a_i X_i)^2-\sum_i a_i^2$. Then $\mathbb E[Q(X)^4]\le 81\bigl(\mathbb E[Q(X)^2]\bigr)^2$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a real coefficient vector indexed by the $n$ coordinates
